clips.title: The story
paras: In the Stonetalon Mountains, Kaya Flathoof is found captive among hostile Grimtotem tauren. Horde adventurers guide her along dangerous mountain trails to Camp Aparaje, then bring word of her survival to her anxious father, Makaba Flathoof.

Kaya Flathoof was captured and held prisoner deep in Grimtotem territory in the Stonetalon Mountains. The tauren clans are divided by bitter rivalries, and few are sharper than the hostility surrounding the Grimtotem. Kaya has escaped captivity, but reaching friendly ground on foot means winding through trails watched by enemies and predators. An armed escort is her best hope of getting through.

Camp Aparaje lies in the eastern Stonetalon Mountains, and Kaya knows the way home from there. She aims for the camp, where she can continue on her own. You guide her through paths where ambushes threaten, helping her avoid recapture on the way to safety.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Thank you for rescuing me! We must leave quickly before they discover that I am free. Please escort me to Camp Aparaje. From there, I know my way.
My father, Makaba Flathoof, will be desperate to know that I am safe.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Kaya is alive! Friend, I have you to thank for rescuing her.

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
